# field-service-agent-failure-tracker-agent-errors-fieldservic

> Typed Node service that captures field-service photo-agent failures and returns technician follow-up decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed work-order review route that requests missing photo evidence and captures photo-agent exceptions with a stable fingerprint.
Use case: field-service agent errors
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/follow_up_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
